collision_integrity_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES location(location_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
collision_integrity_constraints.name: collision_location_id_fkey

collision_integrity_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_record_id) REFERENCES raw_record(raw_record_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
collision_integrity_constraints.name: collision_source_record_id_fkey

collision.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX collision_pkey ON public.collision USING btree (collision_id)
collision.name: collision_pkey

collision.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX collision_source_record_id_key ON public.collision USING btree (source_record_id)
collision.name: collision_source_record_id_key

collision.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_collision_date_id ON public.collision USING btree (crash_date DESC, collision_id DESC)
collision.name: ix_collision_date_id

collision.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_collision_location_date ON public.collision USING btree (location_id, crash_date)
collision.name: ix_collision_location_date

location.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_location_borough ON public.location USING btree (borough_id, location_id)

location.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_location_geography ON public.location USING gist (((geom)::geography)) WHERE (geom IS NOT NULL)

location.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_location_geom ON public.location USING gist (geom) WHERE (geom IS NOT NULL)
location.name: ix_location_geom

location.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX location_location_key_key ON public.location USING btree (location_key)
location.name: location_location_key_key

location.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX location_pkey ON public.location USING btree (location_id)
location.name: location_pkey
